# #464 – Nvidias rapport, månadens handel och allt om Avanza Sigma

**Feed**: avanzapodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode #464 centers on Nvidia's blowout quarter and forward guidance reigniting confidence in the AI-infrastructure buildout, alongside a broad recovery in US software (SaaS) names after fears of AI disruption faded. The hosts debate US vs European/Swedish valuations, review Avanza's monthly customer trading flows (defensive buying, net selling, small-cap fund outflows), introduce the new Avanza Sigma algorithmic discretionary service, and close with Affärsvärlden buy cases on Alimak and Genova.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ALIMK — Alimak | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Affärsvärlden köpråd: quality industrial hoist maker with 40% recurring aftermarket, Latour as anchor owner, accretive ProBell deal; ~30% upside.

#### Reasoning

Analyst Daniel Svensson argues Alimak is a quality company with high aftermarket share, strong ROA and market positions, backed by Latour. The 1.4bn SEK ProBell acquisition at ~8x EBIT and 35% margins supports reaching the 20% margin target. Trading at 10-12x EBIT vs elevator peers ~17x. Assuming margin recovery and 12x multiple yields ~30% upside; a cyclical building-market rebound is the swing factor.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the building/construction market stays weak or deteriorates further
- if the ProBell acquisition fails to lift margins toward the 20% target
- if margins repeat the disappointing Tractel post-acquisition path

> *"Vi tycker det finns en sportslig chans att byggmarknaden utvecklas till nånting bättre än den har varit. Kvalitativt bolag och det är ändå ganska låg värdering om du jämför med annan verkstad."*

---

### 🟢 GEC — Genova Property Group | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Affärsvärlden köpråd: property firm at 53% NAV discount, management business alone justifies price at ~P/E 10, project development on top, high insider ownership.

#### Reasoning

Analyst isolates Genova's management (rental) business and finds it can carry the case alone at roughly P/E 10 on net rental income — among the lowest in the sector — giving the large project-development portfolio 'for free.' 53% NAV discount plus hidden project upside and 61% insider ownership support a buy, though projects are capital-hungry and loss-making, and rising rates pressure all property names.

#### Sell Triggers

- if interest rates rise further
- if project development continues to consume capital and run at a loss
- if insiders continue selling meaningful stakes

> *"Alltså man köper den här fastighetsrörelsen till P/E 10. Och det är lågt alltså. Och då får man ju projektutvecklingen på köpet."*

---
